== Biography ==

The Lory is one of the curious creatures encountered in Wonderland, among those who found their way into Alice's pool. The Lory regards itself with some consequence, insisting to Alice that it must know better by virtue of being older. However, when pressed to substantiate this claim by revealing its age, the Lory steadfastly refused, growing sulky at the challenge.

The creature exhibits a marked sensitivity in its dispositions. When the Mouse recited passages of English history, the Lory shuddered noticeably and pronounced its disapproval with an emphatic "Ugh!" In this way, the Lory revealed itself to be both proud and peculiar in its temperament.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — Lory seems to regard Alice as a rival, having engaged in a prolonged argument with her over matters of age and wisdom. Lory insisted it was older and therefore knew better; when Alice refused to accept this without knowing Lory's actual age, Lory turned sulky.

'''[[Mouse]]''' — Lory and the Mouse were among the creatures who gathered on the shore together.

''Evolution:''
* [[Alice]] — Friendly rivalry (ch.3)<ref>Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chapter 3</ref>
